Key design decisions:

- Package `test`, matching all other integration tests in `SmartBFT/test/`.
- Imports only `fmt`, `os`, `sync`, `testing`, `time` from stdlib, plus `bft "github.com/hyperledger-labs/SmartBFT/internal/bft"` — no testify, no other packages that aren't already in the test package.
- `waitAllDelivered` fans out one goroutine per node, uses a shared `time.After` deadline channel, collects the first error.
- `TestTLATraceNormal` — 4 nodes, 3 sequential submits, calls `waitAllDelivered(nodes, 3, 60s)`, logs but does not fail on timeout.
- `TestTLATraceViewChange` — installs manual `heartbeatTime`/`viewChangeTime` channels, calls `n.Setup()` before `startNodes`, disconnects leader from each peer individually via `DisconnectFrom(uint64)`, drives time with `accelerateTime` on the non-leader slice, submits from node 2.
- `TestTLATraceHBTimeout` — installs manual clocks, calls `n.Consensus.Stop(); n.Setup()` to restart consensus with the new channels, then pumps 5 ticks of 90 s each (well past the 1-minute `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` in `fastConfig`), with 20 ms sleeps between ticks to let goroutines process them.
- All three tests call `bft.InitTLATrace(...)` at the top and `defer bft.CloseTLATrace()`, create the traces directory with `os.MkdirAll`, and use `defer os.RemoveAll(testDir)`.
- Verified with `go build ./internal/bft/` and `go vet ./test/` — both exit 0.
